## Shopee GMV Growth (FY2024) vs. Grab Deliveries GMV Growth (FY2025)

**Shopee (Sea Limited) — FY2024:**
GMV grew **28.0%**, from US$78.5 billion in 2023 to US$100.5 billion in 2024. This growth was driven by a 33.0% increase in order volume (8.2 billion to 10.9 billion orders), partially offset by a slight decline in average order value (~US$10 to ~US$9) [Sea, FY2024, p.97; p.52].

**Grab Deliveries — FY2025:**
Deliveries GMV grew **21%** (approximately 21.4% precisely), from US$11.7 billion in 2024 to US$14.2 billion in 2025, driven by increased consumer demand, platform engagement, and new product features (e.g., Group Orders, Dine Out), along with 17% growth in deliveries MTUs [Grab, FY2025, p.98; p.96].

**Comparison:**
Shopee's e-commerce GMV growth in FY2024 (~28.0%) was notably faster than Grab's deliveries GMV growth in FY2025 (~21%) — a gap of roughly 7 percentage points. Shopee's growth was primarily volume-driven (orders up 33%), while Grab's deliveries growth combined higher transaction volumes with steady GMV-per-MTU gains (deliveries GMV per MTU up 4%, from $539 to $561) [Sea, FY2024, p.97; Grab, FY2025, p.97].
